items.title: PS Plus 11 月游戏包括《死亡岛 2》和《古墓丽影 重制版》
items.summary: Sony has announced next month’s PS Plus offerings, dropping on November 3. If you’re into killing zombies, rog

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2023/03/11/deadisland2-blogroll-1678511428447.jpg
Sony has announced next month’s PS Plus offerings, dropping on November 3. If you’re into killing zombies, roguelite card games, or delving into ancient tombs, you’re in for a treat.
Dead Island 2 , Tomb Raider IV, V, and VI Remastered, and Monster Train 2 are joining the PS Plus library.

Dead Island 2 takes place in a sun-drenched Los Angeles (it isn’t an island, but don’t worry about it) overtaken by hordes of undead. You use modded weapons to slice and smack your way to safety, taking in the bloody and brilliantly layered gore system as you go.

There’s also the Tomb Raider Darkness trilogy, which is composed of Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation, Tomb Raider: Chronicles and Tomb Raider: The Angel of Darkness. These remasters let you switch between the original polygonal graphics and remastered look at will.

Monster Train 2 is a treat for anyone who loves Slay the Spire. Instead of blending card games with RPG-style combat, this sees you use cards to hold enemies off on a moving train, mixing tower defense elements into the recipe. Just one more run. One more. I promise.
The games are all available to redeem from Tuesday November 3 to Monday, November 30. In the meantime, you have until November 2 to redeem last month’s games.

Last month’s PS Plus games were F1 25, Hunt: Showdown 1896 , and Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2. F1 25 is obviously good if you’re a fan of the sport, but the secret best game there is Hunt: Showdown 1896.

Hunt: Showdown is an extraction shooter like no other, where stealth and noise generation are more important than your aim — though that’s also important because you’re rocking old-school Western weapons that take time to reload. It’s deep and brilliant and deserves a way bigger playerbase, especially after its latest updates.
You can browse the PlayStation Plus Extra and Premium Game Catalog on our dedicated page.

items.title: GTA 6's PS5 install size is so big you could store 3500 copies of Balatro inside
items.summary: That's a lot of space to ask for in the midst of the memory crisis.

content.v: While Grand Theft Auto 6 doesn't have a confirmed PC release date yet, we do know it's coming to PS5 and Xbox Series X & S on November 19. Now, we also know that the game file console gamers will need to download is going to be a very big boy indeed, boasting a file size even bigger than Red Dead Redemption 2 .

Reportedly, Grand Theft Auto VI will clock in at a total of 210 GB on PlayStation 5. That's according to PlayStation Game Size on X , who unearths file sizes for upcoming console releases by snooping around the PS Store's backend. I'm sparing a thought for anyone with a creaky internet connection (though at least you can pre-load the game on consoles from November 12, one week earlier).

That 210 GB figure is enough to make your head spin, even if the fully downloaded game doesn't actually end up taking quite that much space on your SSD. That said, a game spread out more than a fifth of a 1 TB drive's total capacity definitely stings during the memory supply crisis .

For comparison's sake, GTA 6's download size is markedly bigger than the 115 GB of available space Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 required at launch. You won't find me tearing through DMZ, but I'm likely still going to have to do some SSD spring cleaning in the not too distant future if those rumours about a Q1 2027 PC release for GTA VI are to be believed (Personally, I think Lauren's prediction that we'll be waiting until at least November next year is more likely).

Currently on PC, Steam says you'll need 105 GB of available space for predecessor GTA V Enhanced. That same game takes up 105.3 GB on PS5. As for Red Dead Redemption 2, Steam recommends 150 GB of space, while the PS store recommends a minimum of 89.20 GB. Obviously, file sizes can fluctuate significantly between updates and bundled-in online modes. But still, based on these two examples alone, I may have to dig deep to find space on my PC for GTA 6.

The biggest game on my rig right now is Silent Hill: Townfall at 73.55 GB, while the biggest game on my Steam Deck is Baldur's Gate 3 at 148.24 GB. Beyond that, I'm much more one for indie darlings—which is just as well because James pointed out to me that GTA 6's file size is roughly equivalent to 3500 copies of Balatro , and 6000 copies of Animal Well . I dread to think just how many times those indie projects' production budgets Rockstar spent developing GTA 6…

items.title: EA 创始人表示，如果《侠盗猎车手 6》在感恩节击败橄榄球，那就是一场胜利
items.summary: Rockstar's GTA 6 is expected to be a giant success commercially, but just how big does the game need to be to

content.v: Rockstar's GTA 6 is expected to be a giant success commercially, but just how big does the game need to be to actually be successful following a decade of development and perhaps one of the biggest development budgets ever ? We don't know, because Take-Two doesn't disclose that kind of information, but EA founder Bing Gordon has his own thoughts.

On the Sozzi Unleashed show, Gordon said it would be "mind-blowing" if GTA 6 can reach 75 million copies sold. How did he arrive at that number? Gordon said he was basing this on a number--750 million--a figure he thought a previous GTA 6 trailer reached. If GTA 6 can sell 10% of that, or 75 million copies, that would be a success, he said.

Gordon was referencing "the preview video," which might have been the GTA 6 Extended Look, which premiered on Netflix and then landed on YouTube. No single video for GTA 6 has 750 million views, but it's not a stretch to think GTA 6 videos distributed everywhere on the internet have reached that number collectively.
Also in the interview, Gordon said another sign of success for GTA 6 is if people play the game instead of watching football on Thanksgiving, which is just a few days after GTA 6 releases.
"I think from my point of view, what success for GTA 6 is going to be on Thanksgiving Day after eating your turkey, you don't watch football, you play GTA," he said.
Of course, it's not a one or the other situation; people will no doubt play GTA 6 and watch football.

Gordon also went on to point out how, in the movie business, a film reaching $300 million is great and $1 billion is obscenely great. Video games can reach those numbers, too, but the film and video game businesses are not directly comparable for many reasons.

GTA 6 is tracking to be a huge hit. Sensor Tower's data claims the game has sold about 7 million copies thus far, generating close to $700 million in revenue. The same company is projecting 25 million preorders by launch, which would work out to about $2 billion in revenue by launch.
The latest data from Circana shows that nearly 1 in 3 console and PC gamers in the US plan to buy GTA 6, and that's the highest purchase intent ever recorded .

items.title: PlayStation Plus 2026 年 11 月免费游戏揭晓
items.summary: PlayStation has revealed this month's batch of free games for PlayStation Plus subscribers. All PS Plus member

content.v: PlayStation has revealed this month's batch of free games for PlayStation Plus subscribers. All PS Plus members will be able to claim a trio of freebies starting November 3: Dead Island 2 , Tomb Raider 4-6 Remastered , and Monster Train 2 . If you haven't claimed October's PlayStation Plus free games yet, make sure to do so before next Tuesday.

Long considered vaporware after its initial reveal in 2014, Dead Island 2 was eventually released in 2023. It's a first-person zombie-slaying game with a surprisingly deep RPG system, impressive amounts of gore, and at least one incredibly creepy undead clown boss fight. It was previously made available through the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog in 2024, but it was removed earlier this year. In case you missed it then, now is your chance to check it out.

Tomb Raider fans looking to celebrate Lara Croft's legacy can grab this compilation of classic games . It includes Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation, Tomb Raider: Chronicles, and Tomb Raider: The Angel of Darkness, all remastered with updated graphics. If you're feeling nostalgic, you can also switch back to the original polygonal look of these old-school games.

Lastly, Monster Train 2 is a real gem of a deckbuilding roguelite. The original game was pretty good, but the sequel improves on it with new gameplay features, a rich art direction, deep build variety, and a pretty rad soundtrack.

items.title: 早在 2004 年，《魔兽世界》就打算拥有可行的职业升级装备，但突袭和地下城的设计师“有点作弊”
items.summary: Getting crafty.

content.v: The design politics of studios in the early 2000s will always fascinate me—not the unsavory stuff, I am glad that is well and truly binned—but rather, the little elbows and feet put on other designers in studios where there wasn't a clear, clean pipeline or a mandate.

Such was the case with Blizzard where, as revealed by principal game designer Kris Zierhut in a recent Polygon interview , there was a little cheeky in-fighting over the power of crafted gear. Zierhut, who joined the company in 2005, was reflecting on the corrections the team wasn't allowed to make during the "no changes" era of Classic in 2019. Corrections that are now possible with World of Warcraft: Forever :

"The only design direction that really existed was: Don't change anything … I was there when we made some of these decisions. I had those discussions with Tom and Jeff and Scott. And I knew some places where we made mistakes."

One such mistake, as the article gets into, is the role that crafted gear had in vanilla WoW—this isn't to say that crafted items were never on the list of best in slot recommendations, but professions were actually meant to give you good gear from the word 'go', with a series of clear outlines for how powerful gear could be.
The problem? Some designers bumped up their gear's power on the sly. "Eric Dodds, the crafting designer, was always very responsible and followed the rules, and other people cheated a little bit."

This is, with over 20 years of hindsight and distance, really funny. The concept of a team of developers quietly bumping up their stats like they're in some gear equivalent of The Big Short—yeah man, just give those boots a few more points of stamina. Dodds isn't gonna know a thing, the sweet fool. But we know the future of WoW is dungeons, dungeons, dungeons, baby!

Anyway, having played the beta, I can confirm that this is indeed addressed. There are a lot of really good blue items that're soulbound which you can craft for yourself if you're, say, a blacksmith or a leatherworker—items that absolutely compete with questing and dungeon items. Crafting is absolutely worth it for your levelling journey.

items.title: 任天堂独立世界上最奇怪的游戏让我放松
items.summary: I often feel compelled to beeline my way through games--I'll do plenty of optional quests, but rarely do I fin

content.v: I often feel compelled to beeline my way through games--I'll do plenty of optional quests, but rarely do I find myself slowing down to take in the sights or just goof around. It's pedal to the metal at all times. My Arms Are Longer Now, which was featured in today's Nintendo Indie World stream , is the rare game to break me out of that compulsion.

A demo was recently released for My Arms Are Longer Now, and despite consisting of just the game's opening level, I spent much longer with it than I would have expected. I often treat demos as a quick taste to get an impression of something before moving on, especially during Next Fests. In the case of My Arms Are Longer Now's demo, I did everything I could and relished in messing around, whether or not doing so connected to any actual objective.

My Arms Are Longer Now is a comedic adventure game of sorts. You control an arm that can extend to unimaginable and unsettling lengths and are tasked with a variety of objectives. In its first level, you ultimately need to steal a briefcase, though doing so requires you to gain access to the right train car, avoid a guard, pickpocket the right passengers, and so on. Along the way, you can steal most everything else that isn't nailed down, slap bystanders around, and generally engage in hijinks.

What makes this so enjoyable is the voice cast, which is made up of dozens of Australian comedians (including Millie Holten, who appeared in the Indie World stream--now's a great time to check out her comedy group's Descent series ). The juxtaposition of this disgustingly long arm and these passengers' subdued reactions to the crimes that it commits were consistently hilarious, and I wanted to poke and prod at every element on the train to be sure I got to experience everything the game allowed me to do.

Sometimes that led to amusing discoveries--be sure you get up to the roof and explore the full length of the train to see what awaits--while other times my exploration led me nowhere. But I realized partway through the demo that I was having a great time investigating everything, in a way I often don't allow myself to because I'm always in a rush to move on to whatever is next. It's a testament to the silliness of the world Toot Games is putting together here that I was able to just chill out and appreciate the world I was in.
My Arms Are Longer Now releases on March 11, 2027 for both Switch and Switch 2, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC. The Steam demo is still available and well worth checking out.

items.title: 《无人深空》在《宇宙》发布一个月后又迎来了恐怖主题的《遗落之族》更新
items.summary: Just as No Man’s Sky lands for iOS, the ever-expanding space sim is getting a spooky new update in time for Ha

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/28/nms-1793200899334.jpg

Just as No Man’s Sky lands for iOS, the ever-expanding space sim is getting a spooky new update in time for Halloween. Forsaken is the latest from Hello Games, which redeemed itself for No Man’s Sky’s poor launch years ago but just keeps going with massive free updates anyway.

Last month, the developer released the No Man’s Sky Cosmos update in time for the game’s tenth anniversary. Cosmos made space more exciting to explore, letting you get close to stars, build your own space station, and explore the wreckage of huge space hulks.

Forsaken aims to show the “darker side of the universe,” according to Hello Games. You’ll be able to search the universe for haunted technology and biological horrors to sell to eccentric traders, but to get them you’ll have to brave the most harrowing corners of the cosmos.

Trading the items grants new seasonal items, including “creepy and organic” shipbuilding options, from alien cockpits to unknowable modules. There are also new cosmetics for your character, from larva tank helmets to writhing, wormy multi-tools. Yummy.

On top of the seasonal stuff, there are also UI tweaks like a better radial menu, a minimal HUD option, and a bunch of other quality of life and accessibility options to tinker with. One of the coolest additions lets you warp straight to any star you can see from your cockpit.
The Forsaken update is available today on all platforms, including the newly minted No Man’s Sky for iOS . Check out the full patch notes on the No Man’s Sky website .

If you’re wondering why Hello Games just keeps going with No Man’s Sky — other than its massive popularity — just look at its upcoming game, Light No Fire. Light No Fire is a sword and sorcery RPG from the team that, instead of simulating an endless galaxy, simulates a more densely packed, to scale planet. An entire planet.

A lot of the updates and tweaks to No Man’s Sky are technical advances Hello Games is using to develop Light No Fire , which will let you soar across the skies on dragonback. We haven’t seen Light No Fire since The Game Awards 2023.
After the sketchy launch of No Man’s Sky, it seems like the Hello Games team plans to let the game speak for itself this time around.

items.title: 游戏界"最佳老婆"引热议 神海伊莲娜简直是灵魂伴侣
items.summary: 近日，一位玩家在社交媒体上晒出《神秘海域》中伊莲娜·费雪与内森·德雷克温馨依偎的游戏截图，并配文称：“The best wifey in gam…

content.v: 由你来说： 《神秘海域》伊莲娜被玩家称为游戏界最佳老婆，有人欣赏她独立聪明、能陪内森出生入死不离不弃。你心目中的游戏最佳老婆是谁？
近日，一位玩家在社交媒体上晒出《神秘海域》中伊莲娜·费雪与内森·德雷克温馨依偎的游戏截图，并配文称：“The best wifey in gaming btw”（顺便说一句，她绝对是游戏界最好的老婆）。
这条帖子迅速引发玩家热议，不少人纷纷表示认同，称赞伊莲娜的人格魅力，以及她与内森之间自然、默契的感情关系。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610282315127791.png
有玩家调侃道：“内森得到的机会远超他应得的，他简直是中了彩票。”还有人表示，每次看到伊莲娜再次登场，都会忍不住感叹：“太爱这个女孩了。”伊莲娜独立、聪明、忠诚的性格，以及她与内森并肩冒险时展现出的默契，都是大家喜爱她的重要原因。
伊莲娜之所以拥有如此高的人气，与她和内森完整的感情发展密不可分。从最初的朋友，到逐渐相爱的恋人，再到最终成为夫妻，两人的关系贯穿了《神秘海域》系列多部作品。玩家不仅见证了他们的冒险，也陪伴着这段感情不断成长。
相比单纯的外貌吸引力，伊莲娜更让玩家欣赏的，是她能够与内森并肩面对危险，也能在冒险结束后与他共同生活。这种独立又可靠的形象，正是许多玩家心中理想伴侣的模样。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610282315571074.png
据了解，伊莲娜·费雪曾被知名游戏媒体 IGN 评为“十大游戏女英雄”还曾被列入“游戏界最令人难忘的女性角色”以及“电子游戏经典美女/独立女性代表”之一，其与男主内森·德雷克的感情线也被游戏界广泛称赞为最真实、自然的伴侣关系之一。
至于谁才是游戏界真正的“最佳老婆”，恐怕每位玩家都有自己的答案。但从这次讨论来看，伊莲娜显然依旧是许多人心中难以替代的存在。

items.title: 《女巫布鲁克》是《星露谷物语》与《魔女宅急便》的结合，终于确定了发行日期
items.summary: Eight years after its reveal, magical cozy game Witchbrook finally has a release date. We’ve been waiting a pa

content.v: Eight years after its reveal, magical cozy game Witchbrook finally has a release date. We’ve been waiting a painfully long time for this Kiki’s Delivery Service-inspired pixel-art experience to break cover, and now we finally know it will be coming to PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2 on January 28, 2027. So you’ll have plenty of time to complete GTA 6 before diving into this severe tonal shift.

At first glance, Witchbrook seems like yet another comfortable life sim along the same lines as Coral Island, Stardew Valley, Story of Seasons, and countless others. The genre is super popular, so developers need to do something incredibly impressive in order to stand out. I’m a sucker for these games even if they don’t push the boat out, but Witchbrook seems awfully determined to innovate on the cozy genre.

If you haven’t heard of Witchbrook before, it’s a lovely little life sim where you fill the role of a new student of Witchbrook College in the gorgeous seaside town of Mossport. The place, as expected, is filled with growing witches and wizards looking to both hone their magical skills and delve deeper into mysteries at the centre of town. You can play alone, or invite three of your friends into the same world to build up businesses, decorate your houses, or engage in a cheeky broomstick race or two. It’s like Studio Trigger’s Little Witch Academia come to life.

Like other games of this ilk, the focus of your journey isn’t just about learning magic, but also making friends with fellow students or local inhabitants as you form relationships that stand a chance of blossoming into romance. I’m immensely eager to find out how deep the narrative goes, since I’d love to see an original magical tale that follows in the footsteps of countless beloved anime I grew up with.

Alongside social mechanics and attending school, you can engage in extracurricular activities like joining an after-school club or entering a cooking competition to hone specific skills that I imagine will allow you to perform more challenging tasks or access more recipes, spells, and so on. Between classes you can seemingly do whatever you want, whether that’s embarking on epic quests or becoming a hermit obsessed with baking.

Putting its gameplay mechanics and luscious aesthetic aside for a second though, I reckon what will draw players in most is the obscene levels of customization. Every single NPC in the game world seems hand-crafted, while the sheer amount of body and clothing options when creating your own character is extraordinary. Trailers have showcased hundreds of outfits over the years along with furniture items that can be placed wherever you see fit. There is so much to this game that it's kind of overwhelming.

Witchbrook has been years in the making, and stands a chance of blowing other cozy sims out of the water if it sticks the landing. I just want to get lost in a magical world for the entirety of February and forget our own exists for a while, and hopefully plenty of others will join me.

items.title: 虽然有点晚，但《都市：天际线 扩展版》在NS2上找到了自己的位置
items.summary: 快把其他的也端上来吧 《都市：天际线 扩展版》（Cities: Skylines – Expanded Edition）在今天正式上线了 NS2平台。 你没看错，这是基于发售于2015年3月的初代《都市：天际线》的移植版

content.v: 快把其他的也端上来吧
《都市：天际线 扩展版》（Cities: Skylines – Expanded Edition）在今天正式上线了 NS2平台。
你没看错，这是基于发售于2015年3月的初代《都市：天际线》的移植版本。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14556/936e7488f3381075a70455f1358c9095.png_mw680water
说实话，刚看到这碗十多年前的“陈年冷饭”被端上NS2时，我第一反应也是犯嘀咕：都 2026 年了，怎么还在移植初代《天际线》？
但在玩了十多个小时的提前测试版、搭起了几个大城区之后，我意识到这次重制还真不是单纯为了卖老玩家的情怀——倒更像是P社给NS2做的一次相当硬核的“模拟经营类专项体检”。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14556/ce40e54ff1d0c62bc2ec2b2440f2fb53.jpeg_mw680water
很多人可能还记得 2018 年初代 Switch 上的《天际线》有多惨。
作为模拟经营圈子里出了名的“优化困难户”和内存黑洞，这游戏哪怕在PC上，后期人口一多，在中端配置上都会卡到寸步难行。当年硬塞进初代 Switch 里的结果，就是可建造区域被死死限制在 9 块地皮，还画面糊成一团、远景全是马赛克，人口稍微上万帧数就变成幻灯片，最后官方甚至因为机能实在扛不住，无奈宣布放弃了后续 DLC 的更新支持。
所以如今在这个直接包含了10个DLC（包括《夜生活》《降雪》《绿色都市》《日落港口》在内的4 个大型资料片、1 个创作者内容包 、 2 个音乐电台 、 3 个小型扩展包还有地图编辑器）的“扩展版”上，甚至有一种终于完成了“自我救赎”的感觉。
当年购买过初代NS版的《都市：天际线》的玩家，更可以在半年内直接以 3 折的售价升级到这个版本。
这次 NS2 版的可建造地块上限增加到了 25 块，画面材质、贴图分辨率、光影和视距对齐了其他主机版本；同时提供了目标 60 帧的性能模式和 30 帧的画质模式。
无论背后的主因究竟是NS2的性能提升，还是P社的优化水平有了鲜明进步，至少都证明NS2现在吃得住这样的经营类游戏了。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14556/c4057e5ce0f09e1a76ce70c9bea64d67.jpeg_mw680water
另外比较值得一提的是，这次的扩展版还是我玩的第一款用上了NS2 手柄鼠标机制的游戏——在游玩中想起这一点时，我甚至有了种“灵光闪现”的感觉。
作为新机型推出时的主要卖点之一，这项功能的实际存在感却一直很弱。即便是在射击游戏中，大家一般也更倾向于直接连操作感更好的外部键鼠。反倒是在玩这对操作精度和频率要求不是那么高的模拟经营游戏时，NS2手柄自带的鼠标功能显得恰到好处。
在掌机形态下可以靠摇杆和快捷选择轮盘悠闲地巡视城市；一旦要大兴土木修高架、划定高密度商业区，又可以随手就把鼠标模式用起来。这也是目前其他几款主流掌机很难提供的体验。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14556/3f58218d4ad5ade68dd8adf4012dee83.png_mw680water
对于类似划线操作来说，舒适度提升很大
体验完这一圈，其实我的思绪已经更加飘向 P 社后面的游戏阵容了。
熟悉 P 社的玩家都知道，他们自家的几部核心大战略看家之作——像《群星》《十字军之王3》《钢铁雄心4》以及《维多利亚3》，这么多年愣是一部都没敢往初代 Switch 上搬。
如今《都市：天际线》打头阵，我想多少验证了这些游戏登上NS2 的可能性，尤其是在UI和操作方面，很可能还比其他主机的手柄操作更加顺手。
这也让我对接下来即将登陆 NS2 的《乐高天际线》（LEGO®天际线）有了更多期待。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14556/302e202164ee56c1f74527ad67c10ff7.jpeg_mw680water
《乐高天际线》宣传PV截图
该作此前已宣布将登陆PC以及包括NS2在内的主机平台。但要说还原那种手搭实体乐高积木的感觉，肯定数NS2的掌机模式更加合适。
希望扩展版的这次尝试，能成为有效的经验。

items.title: 索尼将 90 年代游戏机设计的最佳趋势带到 PS5
items.summary: Sony is embracing one of the best trends of the late '90s and early 2000s, revealing a new line of DualSense c

content.v: Sony is embracing one of the best trends of the late '90s and early 2000s, revealing a new line of DualSense controllers and PlayStation 5 console covers with transparent materials. Dubbed the Prism Collection, it will come in three distinct glossy colors: Flare Orange, Emerald Green, and Graphite Gray. Preorders will open on November 10 through the PlayStation Direct store ahead of a February 4, 2027 rollout.

Sony says the design was inspired by the PS5 design team's interest in giving the console and its accessories a transparent look while also showing off the hardware beneath the protective surface. Flare Orange has a "bold and vibrant aesthetic," Emerald Green offers an "elegant" finish, and Sony says a PS5 will look "refined" with a Graphite Gray cover.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/PRISM-Collection_DS_GREEN_16X9.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/PRISM-Collection_DS_GREY_16X9.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/PRISM-Collection_DS_ORANGE_16X9.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/PRISM-Collection_DSCC_2UP_GREEN_16X9.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/PRISM-Collection_DSCC_2UP_GREY_16X9.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/PRISM-Collection_DSCC_2UP_ORANGE_16X9.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/PRISM-Collection_DSCC_6UP_19X6.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/PRISM-Collection_DSonly_3UP_16X6.jpg?w=636

"We know how much our fans have been looking forward to the return of transparent controllers," Leo Cardoso and Satoshi Aoyagi from Sony's Color, Material, and Finish design team said in a press statement. "We wanted to bring back the iconic see-through trend of the late '90s in a fresh, modern way that complements the PS5's industrial design. "The high-gloss clear finish extends across the back of the controller, offering a look at the technology that powers the DualSense controller while maintaining a sleek, monochromatic look. The metallic finish on the middle cover brings the contrasting surfaces together for a premium appearance that feels consistent with the PS5 generation."

The Prism Collection DualSense controllers have an MSRP of $85 each, while the PS5 console covers are priced at $75 each. If you missed it, Sony also launched limited-edition Marathon and Gran Turismo DualSense controllers this year, and Marvel's Wolverine fans can grab a new PS5 console cover and matching DualSense controller in striking yellow or adamantium-inspired silver, complete with claw marks.

items.summary: Good… new games?

content.v: Cast your mind back to January and you might remember a sit-down we had with some of the leaders of a newly-independent GOG . The DRM-free storefront had separated from its former owner—CD Projekt—and returned to the arms of its original cofounder, Michał Kiciński. Back then, Kiciński told us that publishing was one of the several moves GOG was considering in its post-CDP life. Well, the day has finally come.

"Together with an independent publisher, Retrovibe, we’re joining forces to launch Retrovibe by GOG , a new initiative supporting independent developers in bringing their games to players across PC storefronts and consoles," reads the announcement press release.

The publisher will do, well, publisher stuff. Funding, marketing, hobnobbing with content creators and game journalists (an unenviable task), and getting games certified for release on all of the good Lord's wonderful platforms.

Why has GOG signed up with Retrovibe in particular? Well, there's an affinity between GOG's focus on releasing and preserving old games (good old games, you might say) and Retrovibe's focus on games that capture some sort of classic essence. But a big reason is that Retrovibe was also cofounded by Kiciński: in our January chat, he noted that he had a 50% stake in the publisher.

So it was probably a relatively easy marriage to make happen: "With GOG now under the ownership of its original co-founder, Michał Kiciński, who also co-founded Retrovibe, the two companies have an opportunity to work more closely together," says the announcement, touting Retrovibe's publishing nous and GOG's "platform expertise, marketing capabilities and connection to PC players worldwide."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dUdsUftBR3PhH2TbM6aK3i-1920-80.jpg

The new publishing chimera already has a game under its stamp: Cop Bastard , which releases tomorrow, the 29th of October. It has a very good name and a sort of 'what if you equipped a John Woo protagonist with a bodycam' aesthetic. Our (formerly our) Robin Valentine wrote that there was "definitely something alluring about Cop Bastard's brand of deep-fried retro weirdness" when he tried it last year , though he feared it might not hold up over a full playthrough.

Also on the GOG/Retrovibe docket is Project Warlock: Lost Chapters , the third in the Project Warlock line of boomer shooters. It's not as good a name as Cop Bastard but it does have a great look to it..

You might notice that, despite officially being embraced into the GOG publishing bosom, both those games are not GOG-sclusives. They each have Steam pages as well as GOG releases, which I confess to being quite happy about, if for no other reason than GOG's Galaxy client doesn't yet have its promised Linux build.

items.title: 埃隆·马斯克表示“机器人 RAM 需求将超过地球上的其他一切”，但前提是我们将所有数据中心都投入太空
items.summary: Humanoid robots will still consume only a sliver of the RAM AI does.

content.v: We've been in a global memory shortage for about a year now, causing many of our systems and PC parts to drastically increase in price. Since then, it's very much been a guessing game how long it will all go on for. The primary cause of the shortage has been the insatiable demand of AI data centres, so we've naturally assumed if that dies down or if memory production can match it, all will be well again.

We might worry that the Tesla and SpaceX CEO's proclamation that "Robot RAM needs will exceed everything else on Earth" will prevent this. But it's not something we should worry about for a very long time, as even if the amount of RAM robots use increases and we start producing way more robots, they will still demand far, far less than AI data centres currently do.

There's an element of flippancy to Musk's comments, of course, given he's saying that AI data centers will be housed in space and therefore robots will be the biggest guzzlers of RAM on the planet—this doesn't imply that robots will require more RAM than AI.

In the context of what Musk is replying to on X, it's nevertheless clear he's saying they will demand a lot. Musk's comments are a defence of some Counterpoint research that reportedly claims that by 2030, humanoid robots will demand 20x more DRAM than they do right now.

P Equity Research has shared a chart from Counterpoint which lays out this predicted increase in demand. Apparently, the current 8,300 Tb worth of DRAM demanded by "humanoid robot brains" will increase to 172,000 Tb by 2030.

@zephyr_z9 Silly analysis. Robot RAM needs will exceed everything else on Earth, as you need the robots to be on physical substates in order to shape atoms. Super intelligence needs will vastly exceed that, but ~100% of SI will be deep space compute. Obviously. October 26, 2026

Aside from the obvious fear of a Skynet future, the worry here is that this is another thing that could put severe strain on the memory market and keep the price of our PC components sky-high. There were already predictions that memory supply will still fall short of demand into 2030 and even beyond , so adding a potential 20-fold increase in demand from humanoid robots into the mix can't bode well, right?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/vBmXsjc3QREUbruoi85Kqm-1920-80.jpg

Well, let's not be so hasty. The current global DRAM capacity is estimated to sit at about 40 exabytes (EB). One exabyte is equal to 1,000,000 terabytes (TB), which is equal to 8,000,000 terabits (Tb). 40 EB is 320,000,000 Terabits.

So, when Counterpoint predicts robots will demand 172,000 Tb of DRAM by 2030, it's predicting that robots will demand about 0.05% of the current global DRAM capacity. That's a miniscule sliver of what AI currently demands and what memory makers actually produce. By 2030, the sliver will seem even smaller.

So, I'd say moving our data centres to space would pretty much have to be the requirement for such humanoid robots to have any meaningful impact on the memory shortage. The ball is still firmly in the court of the AI bubble and how that all pans out.

items.title: 暴雪因住房微交易“违背承诺”而引发魔兽世界粉丝强烈反对
items.summary: Back when housing was added to World of Warcraft at the beginning of Midnight, Blizzard issued a set of guidin

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/10/worldthumb-1786385578078.png

Back when housing was added to World of Warcraft at the beginning of Midnight , Blizzard issued a set of guiding priciples that, among other things, promised that the company wouldn't add cosmetics to the cash store that represent one of Azeroth's races or classes. This week, Blizzard broke that promise.

Blizzard released two housing packs yesterday : the Haunted Grimtide Estate pack with a housing exterior and a pre-built interior, along with the Grimtide Decor Pack, which includes 21 different decorations that you can fill that interior with. The company is charging 2,500 hearthsteel for the Haunted Grimtide Estate pack and 1,000 hearthsteel for the Decor Pack, or $25 and $10, respectively.

It would make sense to have a spooky decor pack ahead of Halloween, but the aesthetics of all of these items looks like they were ripped right from Stormsong Valley and the Kul'Tiran humans that debuted in Battle for Azeroth . And the problem there is that charging for packs that so directly reference a WoW race and zone goes directly against the guiding principles that Blizzard itself published when it released housing .

Understandably, a lot of players are upset about these housing packs. One of the biggest WoW influencers, BellularGaming, tweeted a screenshot of Blizzard's promise , adding, "Kul'tiran housing decor bundle in the store! Ever wondered why I dgaf about having a professional relationship with Blizzard anymore? When their words mean nothing, Interviews are a waste of time."

In his replies, user LucasMillican begged players not to buy the items, saying, "Call it out, keep calling it out. Hold them accountable for their words. And for the love of god, people, don’t spend money on it. If you buy it, that tells them it’s okay. Don’t f***ing buy it."
Over on Reddit, WoW fans are rallying around a WindowsCentral article calling out the decor packs, in a thread that has over 660 replies at the time of writing.

User AliceLunar said: "And now here we are, still paying a monthly fee, buying new expansions every other year.. But now we have a whole cash shop, $90 mounts, $75 tree houses, pets, skins, built in RMT, new race locked behind a $30 paywall and the list goes on. WoW has more greedy and insane monetization than a F2P MMO from 20 years ago, but it's not free to play, and people keep opening their wallet."

Another user, Tiroler_Manu , wanted Blizzard to admit it was wrong, saying, "Just openly say: 'Yeah it was a greedy f**k up move, we violated our own principles, we won't do it again, we will give all players this and former house costumizations for free and refund purchases of House customizations. House customizations from now on will not be buyable, except special (non racial) collaborations for charity events (where of course the money will go to the charity).'"

The World of Warcraft cash shop has grown considerably over the last few years, and hasn't shown any signs of slowing down. I'm not sure if community pushback is going to do much for this specific pack, but hopefully there's a chance that it'll dissuade Blizzard from charging for other housing items that so clearly reference the races and classes that players identify with.

This controversy is coming to one of the most popular additions to World of Warcraft in years. When Midnight first launched, housing blew up so much that players (myself included) rushed to collect a ton of housing items to create their Azerothian home. It was so popular, in fact, that Zillow even added a page to show off players' homes.

items.title: 这就是《腐烂国度 3》迄今为止花费了 6 年时间开发的原因
items.summary: State of Decay 3 made an impact at the 2020 Xbox Games Showcase with a slick trailer that teased features that

content.v: State of Decay 3 made an impact at the 2020 Xbox Games Showcase with a slick trailer that teased features that wouldn't make the final cut , like undead deer and frigid landscapes. Six years later, things have changed at developer Undead Labs as it navigates life after Xbox and a shift in gameplay design that led the studio to ditch ideas to make State of Decay 3 an MMO.

Undead Labs founder Jeff Strain planned to make the threequel far bigger than its predecessors, and after his departure in 2019, several design team members kept building the tools to support that vision. Speaking to GamesIndustry.Biz , Undead Labs CEO Philip Holt said the studio scrapped this plan by the end of 2022, choosing instead to rebuild State of Decay 3 to more closely resemble the first two games, which offered both single-player and co-op modes.

"When the founder was here, I think he always had a vision of making an MMO and the ultimate global scale of a zombie apocalypse," Holt said. "And so there was just a different set of creative objectives the team was trying to pursue at that time."

Holt, who previously worked at Guild Wars developer ArenaNet, was well familiar with how challenging it can be to build and maintain an MMO, especially if it becomes successful. Undead Labs eventually pivoted away from its MMO goals for State of Decay 3, and Holt added that the current version has been in development since 2023.

"We basically rewrote the entire State of Decay game, and we will not do that again," Holt added. "We have the benefit now of this pretty significant investment in software that we got to figure out how to make the most of. I think it's highly unlikely that we spend as much time on the next game as we did on State of Decay 3."

Holt previously said the 2020 trailer was made to keep the project and the studio on Microsoft’s radar . Since then, Xbox has divested itself of Undead Labs --and several other studios--and the developer has become an independent employee-owned entity. State of Decay 3 doesn't have a release date yet, but it is still coming to Xbox Game Pass .

items.title: 新电影《饥饿游戏》在《GTA 6》后第二天上映，但导演害怕了吗？
items.summary: GTA 6 launches on November 19, and one day later, the new Hunger Games movie, Sunrise on the Reaping, comes to

content.v: GTA 6 launches on November 19, and one day later, the new Hunger Games movie, Sunrise on the Reaping, comes to theaters. GTA 6 is expected to be an unprecedented hit that captures people's time and attention , especially right at launch. Will this impact Sunrise on the Reaping? That remains to be seen, but director Francis Lawrence hopes people can find time for both.
"Unfortunately, I think it comes out right around the same time our movie does. Hopefully, people find time for both. Play GTA, go see our movie, play more GTA," he joked to IGN .
Other movies releasing on November 20 include the wide releases of Paper Tiger and I Play Rocky.

GTA 6 is the only mainstream game set to release on November 19, with no other big releases set to debut within five days on either side. Publishers are intentionally scheduling releases to avoid GTA 6's blast zone.
Circana's Mat Piscatella told GamesBeat that "everyone's just scared" of releasing near GTA 6, but the data doesn't necessarily back this up.
"I guess I get it, but I just think it’s completely overblown. A lot of these moves and shifting away just seems more irrational than rational," he said.
New data from Circana showed that nearly 1 in 3 US console and PC gamers plan to buy GTA 6 , and that's the highest purchase intent ever recorded by Circana.
Also in the interview, Lawrence listed off some of his favorite video games, including Metal Gear Solid, BioShock, Call of Duty, and the original GTA.
Lawrence singling out BioShock is no surprise, as he's attached to direct the upcoming BioShock movie for Netflix ... if it ever gets made .

content.v: 苹果首款折叠屏iPhone Duo开售尚不足一周，屏幕故障风波还在持续发酵。继大量用户反馈内屏开裂、漏液问题之后，网上又出现全网第一例外屏损坏案例，进一步引发市场对该机品控的讨论。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610282228482870.png
根据网友投稿，这台iPhone Duo无摔落、无磕碰经历，在外屏打开短视频App刷了几条内容之后，屏幕直接出现绿线。有意思的是，绿线出现的位置，恰好对应短视频应用未适配所留下的黑边区域，故障成因暂时没有明确结论。
接连爆出的屏幕问题，也让不少数码博主表示，这次iPhone Duo的实际表现，让大众对苹果的工业设计、品控与供应链管理产生重新审视。
此前苹果官方已经发布声明，确认注意到少量iPhone Duo出现内屏故障，建议遭遇问题的用户联系AppleCare申请换机。苹果同时强调绝大多数设备不受影响，存在缺陷的机型一般会在初期就暴露故障。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610282229053572.jpg
IDC分析师对此表示，哪怕是拥有顶尖工程实力、强大供应链管控能力的苹果，进军折叠屏赛道同样要面对陡峭的学习曲线，折叠形态的硬件制造依旧存在不小挑战。
海外科技媒体TheVerge评价，iPhone Duo创新方向清晰，但作为初代探索机型，产品成熟度不足，存在诸多妥协。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610282229146034.jpg
综合首批用户反馈来看，该机起售价高昂，但综合体验难以匹配定价，更偏向一台技术试水作品，普通消费者更建议等待第二代迭代产品。

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/28/nintendo-indieworld-blogroll-1793194541587.jpg
Nintendo’s Indie World Showcase is over, and we’ve got a roundup of all the announcements right here!
Witchbrook release date

Indie World Showcase kicked off with a big announcement: Chucklefish's Witchbrook finally has a release date! The hotly anticipated magical life sim is coming in to PC, Nintendo Switch 1 and 2, and Xbox on January 28, 2027. There's a new gameplay trailer, too. That's not all. Outside of Indie World Showcase, Chucklefish confirmed plans for a PlayStation 5 port.
Here's the official blurb:
Winds of Viridia demo
Winds of Viridia is due out early 2027, with a free demo available from the eShop today.
City of None reveal
City of None is a new indie game coming from one of the co-creators of the much-loved Celeste. It's due out next year. Here's the official blurb from Nintendo:
Sword of the Sea is coming to Nintendo Switch 2
Giant Squid's 2025 adventure video game Sword of the Sea is coming to Switch 2 on October 29.
Tenjutsu Switch 2 confirmed

The lead designer of Dead Cells has a new game, Tenjutsu, which is now confirmed for Nintendo Switch 2. Dead Cells designer Sébastien Benard’s fast-paced, full-blooded action roguelike is coming to Switch 2 alongside PC in 2027, and we've got a new gameplay trailer.
Threads of Time

Riyo Games and Balor Games’ turn-based RPG Threads of Time has a summer 2027 launch on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PC via Steam, and Xbox Series X|S. The Switch versions were also revealed today during Nintendo’s Indie World showcase.
Dumpster Gang

Dumpster Gang from Curve Games and Coyote House Games is a chaotic online sandbox that charges players with solving puzzles and stealing everything they can carry as a trash panda. It's due out on Switch 2 next March.
Super Battle Golf
Super Battle Golf lets up to eight players battle in chaotic golf games. It's due out on Switch 2 on March 25, 2027.
R.E.P.O.
semiwork's viral viral online co-op extraction horror game R.E.P.O. is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027. It launched on Steam in early access form last year and blew up.
Haunted Paws
Haunted Paws from LazyFlock is a two-player cosy adventure where you play as a puppy. It's due out next May, with a free demo available on the eShop later today.
Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino

We have a new trailer for Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino, from Japanese developer Rias. Kitsune is a fox girl who finds herself on Adashino Island and starts travelling with her Frog friend. Neon signs give light and color to the island with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. It comes out spring 2027.
Slime Rancher 2
Monomi Park's Slime Rancher 2 launches on Switch 2 in January 2027.
Spirit Crossing
Spirit Crossing, from from Spry Fox, launches as a console exclusive on Switch 1 and 2 on November 16.
My Arms Are Longer Now

My Arms Are Longer Now from Toot Games and Jackbox Games is a physics-based heist game where you play a really long arm. Yes, really. It's developed by an Australian indie developer and features voice acting from actual Australian comedians. It's due out March 11, 2027.
Petal Runner
Switch 2 console exclusive Petal Runner, from Nano Park Studios, has a release date: March 8, 2027. There's a demo going live on the eShop today, too.
Raccoin: Chaos Max Edition

Raccoin: Chaos Max Edition, from Playstack and Doraccoon, launches on Switch 2 on November 10, 2026, alongside an exclusive in-game arcade cabinet skin. Preorders and a free demo go live on the eShop later today.

items.title: 能实现60帧？曝《GTA6》主机版或有“性能模式”！
items.summary: 近日，推特博主Frizky晒出两张疑似《GTA6》早期开发版本的调试界面截图，其中出现了“Fidelity”（画质/保真）和“Performance”（…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610282218337447.png
据T5G报道，近日，推特博主Frizky晒出两张疑似《GTA6》早期开发版本的调试界面截图，其中出现了“Fidelity”（画质/保真）和“Performance”（性能）相关选项，引发玩家对游戏主机版画面表现与帧率的讨论。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610282218375659.png
从截图来看，第一张调试菜单中出现了“Fidelity - 1440-2160 - 5JR”等字样，同时显示帧率、CPU和GPU占用率等实时数据；第二张截图则出现了与“Performance”有关的信息。
目前，许多主机大作都会提供画质模式与性能模式，允许玩家在画面表现和运行流畅度之间进行取舍。因此，有玩家猜测，Rockstar也可能为《GTA6》加入类似设置，以适应不同主机的硬件表现和玩家需求。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610282219477460.png
其中，性能模式能否实现60帧，成为玩家最关注的话题之一。此前，网络上曾有传闻称，《GTA6》主机版可能仅提供30帧运行表现，主要原因是现役主机的CPU性能可能成为限制游戏帧率的瓶颈。
如果此次截图中的选项确实对应《GTA6》的画面设置，那么性能模式或许意味着玩家能够在画质与流畅度之间进行选择。不过，目前截图的真实性、具体选项含义以及游戏最终支持的帧率均未得到官方确认，不能据此认定《GTA6》将支持60帧模式。

《影之刃零》 预售进行中 ！叠加金币至高省40元，每周抽10份免单，还送大作优惠券！
在更新说明中，Gamekult的评测者详细解释了改分的原因。文章指出，在最初的评测版本中，游戏存在一个严重的“软锁”Bug，导致一个支线任务无法正常推进。这直接阻碍了评测者达成真正的结局，使其无法完整验证游戏的全部内容。经过与开发工作室S-GAME的沟通，并应用了官方后续推送的补丁后，这个问题已经得到圆满解决。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610280912214866.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610280913123984.png
此外，Gamekult还删除了原文中关于“各种技术问题”的段落。评测者解释称，官方在周末发布的补丁不仅修复了软锁Bug，还同时解决了他此前在游玩中频繁遇到的性能下降（掉帧）问题。基于这些实质性的修复，评测者决定修改这篇评测，以反映游戏在正式发售时玩家实际可以体验到的水准。
不过，评测者在文章末尾也保持了谨慎的态度。他表示，由于时间关系，自己并没有时间重新游玩并验证整个游戏流程，因此他依然提醒玩家，要对游戏最终的技术完成度保持一定的警惕。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610280912327051.jpg
从7分到8分，这次评分调整反映出《影之刃零》开发团队在临近发售前对游戏进行了密集且高效的修复。
对于玩家而言，一个能在首发时解决恶性Bug并优化性能的版本，显然才是大家真正关心的。

items.title: 《影之刃零》制作人发长文！三点关键 首日补丁5G
items.summary: 《影之刃零》的制作人梁其伟今日发文。

content.v: 《影之刃零》制作人梁其伟在游戏发售前约 20 小时发表了题为《理性与癫狂》的感言长文。
他在文中回顾了 20 年前初次用 RPG Maker 制作游戏的经历、《影之刃零》的开发历程、团队藏着某种“癫”和“痴”的创作激情、游戏的设计理念等等。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/377ae19d06ad77cadfaf189f15bf3f5a/
此外他还在文末补充了三条提示：首日补丁大约 5G；N 卡驱动建议使用 617.42 版本（最新的 621.01 驱动存在部分不稳定的性能表现）；光栅化美术的表现也很优秀，即使关闭光追，仍然可以完美传达场景的美术设计风格，中低端机器乃至于掌机的体验也经过了大量测试，值得大家尝试。
以下是全文：
理性与癫狂
现在距离《影之刃零》上线大约还有 20 小时。
https://wx1.sinaimg.cn/large/552007e4ly4iii04bdcpjj21160eagrt.jpg
20 年前，我在学校开始制作自己的第一部独立游戏《雨血：死镇》。在这款用 RPG Maker 制作的业余游戏里，我用稚嫩的技术构建了一个心目中的幻想世界：一个以中国传统武侠为根基，又融入人体改造、平行世界等元素的”影境“。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/2212018d0d42c85a6460d1e1fedfee9a/
那时的我，并不知道未来的人生与职业会走向何方。制作游戏原本只是我在求学期间的精神寄托，却在不知不觉中，成为了我生命中最重要的一部分。
3 年多以前，当带着第一版还相当粗糙的《影之刃零》预告片登上PlayStation的发布会时，我们看起来像是个有点胆大妄为，贸然把半成品曝光在全球观众的审视下的新工作室。“影之刃”也只是又一个原创 IP，其中的世界，人物，故事对大多数人来说是完全陌生的。
但是从那时起，我们开启了一段美妙而史诗般的旅程。
我们砍掉了其它在研项目，不断拓展制作规模、提升作品精度，并倾尽所能，汇聚技术、经验、资源与各方协助：数千小时的动作捕捉，遍访中国城镇与山村进行的 3D 扫描，由广东舞狮大师指导的舞狮、由峨眉剑术大师指导的剑阵、由少林寺僧人指导的拳法。除此之外，我们还组建了一只高效，专业的武打动捕团队，由动作导演羊柳带领，并在我们的偶像——甄子丹的顾问下，为游戏制作了不计其数的攻击，防御，躲闪，连招，处决动作……

关于《影之刃零》，你可能已经看到了许多的评测，但实际上你可能又不需要看太多。明天进入游戏后，你会发现一切玩法都显得自然，简单，熟悉，但我们把这些熟悉的玩法重新创作了一遍，并将它们组合成了一个新的整体——几年来，我们深度思考了整个 ARPG 及动作游戏的许多“祖宗之法”，研究究竟什么是玩家最想要的元素，以及如何将这些元素组合起来达成我们的目的——让所有喜爱武侠文化，喜欢动作表现的玩家都乐在其中。毕竟这是一款游戏，它存在的目的是为了让大部分人感到好玩，放松和享受，同时给那些追求挑战的玩家热血沸腾的额外刺激。
在研发的几年中，我们在各种展会，试玩会上与大量普通玩家进行交流，从国内的北京到上海，从美国洛杉矶到巴西圣保罗……我们体会到玩家的需求，并在一些细枝末节的地方同样争取做好：
https://wx2.sinaimg.cn/large/552007e4ly4iii04bs4qsj21900u0gt9.jpg
譬如，我们的音频设置中拥有“刀剑碰撞音色”调节选项，玩家可以自主设置拼刀时的感受；我们的PS5版中拥有三种不同的键位布局（PC 版则可更灵活地自由设置）；另外，我们对主流的屏幕比例都进行了适配，包括16:9的显示器，电视，16:10 的笔记本，掌机，还有超过 3:1 的超宽屏幕等。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/202b96700f3cc6fc213d1b38883162c1/
但是研发不总是那么理性的，那些感性和疯狂的元素也许铸就了游戏中最“美味”的部分。我们的几场重要的战斗，都由几位年轻的 00 后同事完成；我们全部的角色和大部分的场景设定，由 Michael 一个人全部画完；更不用说“无法无天”的阿薄了——他独自完成了超过 10 小时的音乐素材，除了部分特殊乐器和演唱外，他做了全部工作，包括作曲，演奏，混音，还指导完成了游戏内的播放控制，音量控制等。
在进行了多年的研发后，我觉得“技术”和“经验”已经是无需讨论的基础话题，我最关注的，反而是大家的“精神状态”，是否在超越了技术和经验后，藏着某种“癫”和“痴”——武侠游戏做着做着，我们自己似乎也成为了武侠中的那种人物。
在这几年中，我没少对团队说的一句话是“今天我要宣布一个令人窒息的决定”，这往往意味着把某些大家按部就班做完，但已经打造精良的东西拆掉，重构，甚至彻底放弃，同时也意味着大量的返工，或把包含大量工作量的内容直接舍弃，感谢团队的支持和理解，我们做到了！我们已经将所有的思考和创造力，灌注在这部作品之中。
《影之刃零》的存在，是为了让你感觉到自身的强大和炫酷，无论任何敌人出现在你的面前，你最终会将他们击败。这种感受不是通过简单的“告知”实现的，而是通过你挥出去的每一刀，每次格挡，每个闪避，以及那眼花缭乱的暴力美学处决来体现的；敌人的强大也是为了衬托你自身的强大，乃至那看起来黑暗，略显悲剧的背景故事——六十六天生命倒计时，也是为了让这种强大由外在而拓展到内心。
现在，我们郑重邀请你体验《影之刃零》。它一方面源自我当年求学时在困苦与迷茫中创作的那部独立游戏；但它也凝聚了我们在能力所及之内所能倾注的一切。
这是一部以炽热的心打造的，具有庞大体量的作品。这是一小群热爱游戏的人（只不过恰巧也是开发者），献给所有热爱游戏的人的礼物。
我们“影境”江湖见！
发布前收到同事同步的三条信息：
1，我们赶在发售前准备了一个首日补丁，大约 5G 大小，可以极大提升光线追踪和路径追踪的性能，以及部分 bug 修复。如果你在此前完成了预下载，可以在启动游戏前进一步更新补丁后再开始游戏，如果没有预下载，那么直接下载的就是最新版本。
2，我们花费了大量时间用于提升光栅化的美术表现，即使关闭光线追踪，仍然可以完美传达场景的美术设计风格。中低端机器乃至于掌机的体验也经过了大量测试，值得大家尝试。
3，我们发现 Nvidia 最新的 621.01 驱动存在部分不稳定的性能表现，经过测试，617.42 驱动是目前适配《影之刃零》最为理想的驱动版本。如果已经更新到617.42之后的版本，驱动界面下面有近期版本可以选择对应版本进行重新安装(选择清洁安装)，并等待 Nvidia 的新一版驱动更新（相信他们很快就会发布）。

items.title: Proton 的黑色星期五促销已经开始：抛弃 Google，VPN 最高可享受 70% 折扣，无限制套餐可享受 50% 折扣
items.summary: That's just $2.99 a month for Proton VPN.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Ub4gesmHm87ZXx7Vzxkv54-1920-80.jpg

Unlimited (12-month): was $155.88 now $77.88 Full access to the Proton suite of applications here for $6.49/month. You have to pay in full for the entire year, but you get a VPN, mail service, a cloud drive with 500 GB of storage, a calendar, and an authenticator.
Access to: Proton VPN | Proton Pass | Proton Mail | Proton Drive | Proton Calendar | Proton Pass View Deal
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/pwcQgMrJKS6THYS9jYxfjn-1920-80.jpg
Key info: 120+ countries | Blocks ads, trackers and malware | Up to 10 devices at once | No logs View Deal
Yes, it may seem a bit early for companies to announce their Black Friday deals, but Proton's collection of reductions is so good it's worth the name drop.

Starting off, you can pick up Proton Unlimited for $6.49 a month . You do have to pay just shy of $80 up front for the year, but that's the price of what would usually get you just six months of Proton Unlimited.

And for that monthly cost, you are getting a lot of tools. You get Proton's mail and calendar services, which are a solid alternative to Google. They are privacy-focused, with end-to-end encryption and totally ad-free (unlike Google).
Proton Unlimited also gives you access to Proton Drive, a Google Drive alternative that is once again security-focused, and you get 500 GB with this plan.

Also included in Proton Unlimited is Proton Pass, a password generator and storage service. That means you won't have to remember your passwords, and you can be assured it picks safe and nearly impossible-to-guess passwords.
Finally, you get Proton VPN, which encrypts your traffic, masks your IP address and allows you to bypass geo-restrictions on online services.
If you are looking to pick up Proton VPN by itself, it's cheaper if you go in on the 24-month plan. This will cost you just over $70, or $3 a month. That is a saving of $168.
If you are based in the UK, this is still available there too, with the Proton VPN subscription being £2.39 a month and Proton Unlimited being £5.19 a month .

Still, no matter which Proton service you go for, there are super solid plans available this Black Friday. They are well worth taking advantage of if you've been looking for an excuse to ditch Google, or simply don't like how much of your traffic is traceable online.

content.v: Hakoom是一位来自沙特阿拉伯的知名硬核玩家，因长期疯狂收集PlayStation白金奖杯而被中国玩家称为“沙特肝帝”。
《影之刃零》 预售进行中 ！叠加金币至高省40元，每周抽10份免单，还送大作优惠券！
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610281704308841.png
日前，Hakoom发文表示，自己购买的《影之刃零》数字豪华版激活码无法在Steam平台使用，仅能在中国WeGame平台激活。随后，他决定以50美元的价格出售这份WeGame豪华版激活码（美区原价70美元）。
从其晒出的订单截图来看，该订单的下单时间为2026年8月19日，价格显示为0元。不过，仅凭截图尚无法确定该激活码的具体获取渠道，有玩家根据订单样式发现这疑似京东平台购买“实体收藏版”附带的游戏兑换码。

items.title: 《影之刃零》首个白金奖杯被媒体拿走！玩家破防？
items.summary: 《影之刃零》尚未发售，就已经有媒体获得了白金奖杯，这让很多普通玩家感到不满，对此你怎么看？

content.v: 由你来说： 《影之刃零》尚未发售，就已经有媒体获得了白金奖杯，这让很多普通玩家感到不满，对此你怎么看？
《影之刃零》 预售进行中 ！叠加金币至高省40元，每周抽10份免单，还送大作优惠券！
《影之刃零》还未正式发售，但已经有媒体通过官方提供的评测版本抢先体验，并拿到了全球玩家首个白金奖杯。
这一情况在社区曝光后，迅速引发了关于“媒体评测特权”与“普通玩家冲榜”的激烈讨论。
有网友发文质疑，外媒用官方评测码提前白金、抢占普通玩家首白的行为在观感上“不厚道”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610280952141854.png
该网友指出，评测码的初衷是为了完成游戏评测，而不是用来占据公开的玩家白金榜单。国内外都有热衷冲刺首白的玩家圈子，媒体利用提前拿到游戏的时间优势和信息优势去抢首白，显然影响了那些准备冲榜的普通玩家的公平性。
该网友直言：“官方没限制，媒体是合规但不体面，为什么不能说了？”
针对这一争议，玩家们的观点呈现出明显的两极分化：
认为媒体行为不妥的网友表示：媒体拿评测码属于工作需要，但不应该用这种工作渠道的提前优势去占榜。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610280952286198.jpg
甚至有网友建议，官方干脆在明天游戏正式发售时把榜单清理一下，等玩家去争。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610280952293310.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610280952307667.jpg
部分玩家认为，评测游戏的成就系统本身就是媒体工作的一部分。评测人员能打出白金，至少说明他们仔细体验了游戏的所有内容，这对于准确评价一款游戏的好坏十分必要。
也有网友指出，白金奖杯并不难拿，有些媒体可能根本不是在刻意“刷榜”，只是在为了评测而深度体验的过程中，顺其自然地就白金了。
还有玩家表示：“人家白金也不影响你白金，这说明他十分喜爱这款游戏。”此外，也有人认为这本质是官方没有提前做好限制，不能全怪媒体。
目前，《影之刃零》即将于10月29日正式发售。

content.v: 据分析机构Alinea Analytics估算，《影之刃零》在正式发售前的预售销量已达85万份。
《影之刃零》 预售进行中 ！叠加金币至高省40元，每周抽10份免单，还送大作优惠券！
随着媒体评测的正式解禁，本作的强劲势头和极高口碑正在为其带来更亮眼的商业表现。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610280921506572.jpg
从平台占比来看，Steam平台贡献了73.8%的预售销量，PS5平台占26.2%。在地区分布上，约62.5%的预售销量来自中国、中国台湾或中国香港地区，其中主要是中国大陆市场。这一地区在Steam平台的销量占比高达75.9%，在PS5平台约占24.9%。
在收入方面，本作预售阶段的营收已达4300万美元。其中Steam平台占69.2%，PS5占30.8%。报告指出，由于区域定价策略以及Steam在低价区销量份额较高，导致收入占比与销量占比出现了一定差异。

令人惊叹的是，尽管游戏尚未正式发售，且未登陆Xbox平台，但它已经成功跻身2026年新游戏收入榜的前40名。

标准版iPhone 18
目前，iPhone 18的具体升级内容尚不明确，但传闻称，该机可能配备更大的运行内存。此外，新机也有望在散热设计方面进行改进，并搭载全新的苹果C2基带。外观方面，苹果也有可能调整iPhone 18的设计，使其更加接近iPhone 17 Pro和iPhone 18 Pro的风格。不过，目前还没有明确消息能够证实这一点。
配置方面，iPhone 18预计将搭载A20芯片。价格方面，该机可能维持899美元的起售价，与目前的iPhone 17相同。值得注意的是，iPhone 17的起售价此前已从799美元上调至899美元。
iPhone 18e（传闻或改名iPhone Neo系列）
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610282206296759.png
目前来看，这款入门机型可能主要进行芯片升级，从A19换用A20处理器。此前有报道称，苹果计划让iPhone 18与iPhone 18e共享不少硬件组件，但具体涉及哪些部件，以及这些调整会对两款手机产生什么影响，目前仍不清楚。
iPhone Air 2
初代iPhone Air上市后的市场反响较为平淡，苹果随后重新考虑了产品设计，并决定为新机加入一颗超广角摄像头。由于这项调整，iPhone Air 2未能在此前的发布周期中如期推出。
超广角摄像头对于日常使用的重要性未必有那么高，但手机背面只有一颗摄像头，容易让消费者觉得产品档次不够高。因此，为了提升产品吸引力，增加超广角摄像头仍可能成为一项重要升级。当然，超广角镜头本身也能带来一些有趣的拍摄效果。
iPhone Air 2也有可能采用更小尺寸的灵动岛设计，类似于iPhone 18 Pro。
基带方面，新机预计将从苹果C1X基带升级至C2基带。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610282206375682.png
续航也是此次升级的潜在重点。据称，iPhone Air 2的电池容量可能增至3500mAh左右，相较初代iPhone Air提升约10%。

items.title: 外媒点评影之刃零：战斗近乎完美 但反而有个问题
items.summary: 评论者认为战斗与世界观出色，但大量必读文档让剧情推进显得割裂。

content.v: 前几日，在《影之刃零》媒体评测解禁之后，外媒GameRant在评测报告中为《影之刃零》 给出了9/10的高度评价 ，夸赞了游戏的战斗系统、美术设计和音乐等内容，但指出游戏的部分剧情有些难以令人共鸣。
《影之刃零》 预售进行中 ！叠加金币至高省40元，每周抽10份免单，还送大作优惠券！
今日，该评测的作者Nick Rodriguez发布了一篇专栏文章，再次强调《影之刃零》的战斗系统近乎完美，但仍有一个问题，并详细解释了为什么最终选择扣掉一分。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/28/cas_auto/small_0_9112051.jpg
Nick Rodriguez指出：“《影之刃零》强劲的动作玩法与叙事方式并不相称。”《影之刃零》有许多出色的过场动画，但他认为，游戏的大部分叙事内容实际上是通过文本文件、物品描述和“记忆之花”呈现的。后者本质上是一种类似音频日志的设计，多个片段共同讲述着一些规模较小的故事。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/28/cas_auto/small_0_9112053.jpg
作为一名FromSoftware游戏的忠实粉丝，这些叙事手法对他来说再熟悉不过，他也欣然接受了这种设计。然而，FromSoftware对这种含蓄、晦涩的叙事呈现有一套非常独特且完整的处理方式，其中并不包括大量《影之刃零》这种索尼式的3A级过场动画。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/28/cas_auto/small_0_9112054.jpg
最终，在Nick Rodriguez看来，《影之刃零》的故事呈现出一种两边都沾的状态：它既是一款注重电影化表现的动作游戏，也是一部晦涩、高深的黑暗奇幻作品。它像FromSoftware的游戏一样富有深度，同时又试图讲述一个如顽皮狗作品那般紧张激烈、节奏迅猛的故事，而这两种风格的结合并不总能奏效。
例如，《影之刃零》在游戏中设定了一个为期66天的倒计时，某些事件发生后，游戏内的日期就会推进，例如与特定检查点互动。这种设定再加上始终保持高强度的动作玩法，似乎都在暗示剧情具有很强的紧迫感。但当玩家为了理解故事，不得不花费大量时间仔细阅读文本记录、收听音频日志，而不是亲自推动事件发展时，就很难真正感受到这种紧迫感。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/28/cas_auto/small_0_9112056.jpg

不过，他也再次澄清表示，《影之刃零》非典型的叙事方式本身并没有错。他并不认为《影之刃零》的故事讲得不好。事实上，他很喜欢它那些非传统的叙事方式，以及优先通过背景设定来展开故事的做法。问题不在于《影之刃零》必须在不同的叙事方式之间“二选一”，而在于它应该继续打磨和精简自身传达背景设定与剧情信息的方式。这样做不仅能让未来的《影之刃零》作品更容易被更广泛的剧情向游戏玩家接受，也能让这一IP在整个动作RPG领域中变得更加成熟、更具独特性。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/28/cas_auto/small_0_9112057.jpg

Nick Rodriguez总结表示，他非常欣赏《影之刃零》中的各种文档，尤其是记忆之花。这些内容本身写得很好，他也成功地将其中一些线索串联起来，甚至提前猜到了几个要过好几个小时才会揭晓的重要剧情转折。但其中一些文档实际上是理解剧情和游戏世界观的必读内容，而并非所有玩家都喜欢这种叙事方式。当玩家不得不暂时放下近年来最出色的动作RPG战斗体验，转而阅读这些必读材料时，部分玩家难以迅速从激烈的战斗节奏中抽离出来，也就不足为奇了。
https://imgs.gamersky.com/upimg/new_preview/2026/09/24/origin_202609241120117407.jpg

content.v: Palit与影驰正式否认“影驰显卡生产将关闭”的传闻，确认没有任何制造设施被关闭，生产和业务仍在正常运行。相关产品继续供应本地及国际市场，客户支持也未宣布变化。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261028/1793196305_995549.webp
两家公司同时确认，Palit与影驰处于同一集团，并共用生产设施。此次澄清针对前一天出现的消息：相关说法援引行业消息人士称，NVIDIA GPU供应不足促使Palit关闭影驰工厂，并推测影驰、欧洲品牌KFA2及名人堂系列最终可能消失，制造资源将转向Palit和耕升产品。影驰在声明中直接否认了这些说法。
类似传闻此前也曾出现。今年4月，Palit曾说明，将影驰、KFA2和名人堂的品牌管理集中至集团总部属于内部重组，并不意味着退出GPU市场。
本轮传闻出现前数日，影驰还于10月22日发布了GeForce RTX 5080 HOF Extreme。目前，两家公司明确表示工厂未关闭；GPU供应情况及集团内部产能分配，则仍需与未经证实的市场传言区分看待。

items.summary: 该项目由粉丝团队制作，保留原版规则，并支持实时调整光影与滤镜效果。

content.v: 据DSOGaming报道，OpenCNC 3D团队已为1996年《红色警戒》加入支持，玩家可以在现代PC上以全新3D画面游玩这款经典RTS。该项目由粉丝制作，利用原版代码开发，在保留原版游戏的核心规则与玩法的同时，还可切换原版2D外观与名为“Enhanced（增强版）”的3D模式。
视频欣赏：
据了解，Enhanced模式加入实时光照、阴影等视觉效果，建筑、单位和地形更有层次；爆炸可以照亮周边区域，烟雾、碎片和弹坑让战斗细节更丰富。单位和建筑会投射阴影，游戏还在原有动画帧之间做运动混合，让移动更平滑。

items.title: 《剑星：血雨》TGA要放大招？假小子要有新素材了
items.summary: 《剑星：血雨》TGA要放大招？假小子要有新素材了

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271437383402.png
《剑星》系列续作《剑星：血雨》或许很快会有新消息？近日，Shift Up CEO兼游戏制作人金亨泰转发了游戏颁奖典礼TGA主持人Geoff Keighley发布的宣传动态，引发玩家猜测：这款备受期待的动作游戏是否准备在今年的TGA上公开新预告，甚至展示更多实机内容？
TGA一直是大型游戏公布新作、发布预告和展示实机的重要舞台，因此金亨泰此次转发相关动态，很快引起了《剑星》粉丝的注意。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271438512664.png
《剑星：血雨》于今年6月的夏日游戏节正式公布，是《剑星》的后续作品，故事将延续前作的世界观，并引入新主角伊薇（Evie）。此前公开的首支预告展示了雨夜城市、怪物袭击以及近身格斗场面。与前作伊芙以剑术为核心的战斗风格不同，伊薇更加偏向拳套格斗和踢击，同时也会使用刀刃类武器。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271438589706.png
Shift Up此前表示，续作仍处于开发早期阶段，团队希望在前作的战斗、美术和世界构建基础上进一步拓展体验。金亨泰也曾透露，只有当作品准备充分、确实有值得展示的内容时，团队才会再次公开更多信息。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271439131510.png
今年TGA将于12月10日举行，官方目前尚未公布完整的游戏展示名单。如果《剑星：血雨》届时亮相，玩家或许能看到更完整的战斗演示、剧情线索，甚至进一步了解游戏的开发进度。

items.title: Monster Train 2 is getting a new clan, and they're edgy as h̶e̶l̶l heaven
items.summary: And it's coming to mobile and handheld platforms.

content.v: The new clan coming to Monster Train 2 is a set of dark angels and assorted heavenly outcasts called The Punished. They love pain, they love chains, and they're coming as DLC on November 10 for $7.99 , developer Shiny Shoe announced today.
The Punished are "led by playable warrior Archus, Darkness Incarnate, and a peerless ability to convert The Punished’s suffering into power within combat," says the studio.

Like the other DLC clan added in February, The Railforged , The Punished have a unique clan mechanic in the form of a static interaction button—the Monolith, to which cards can be sacrificed to gain Zeal, which buffs units.

New units revealed today include Reaper of Suffering, a 60 attack / 25 defense sweep unit that sounds quite powerful on paper, but is suppressed when you first play them. There's also Scarred Justicar, which gains +15 attack on a new keyword, "Punish," and Collector of Sorrows, a hooded figure with a new ability called Restitution.

Shackles of Spite looks like a powerful piece of equipment, a common that makes a unit deal double damage while their life total is at 50 percent or less (it also grants 10 HP). The other few spells revealed in the announcement emphasize global or self-damage.

"When we sat down to make a new clan, we're like, what can we do that feels unique and is a design space we hadn't explored? And we came up with a bunch of different ideas and tried some things, but the one we liked the most was self-damaging, being a risk-reward mechanic for boosting power in a variety of ways," Shiny Shoe CEO Mark Cooke told me. "That's what The Punished are all about. It's about using the pain on your own units to your gain. All of the new triggers and status effects really surround that kind of core idea."

The Punished will be Monster Train 2's final post-launch update, which apparently more than 1 million people have played since its launch in 2025. The studio also announced that Monster Train 2 will be released on iOS, Android, and Nintendo Switch 2 sometime later this year (The Punished will likewise be available on those platforms).
I've been playing The Punished ahead of their release and will share my impressions in a further story early next month.

items.title: 'Yes, we are vibe-coding things': Epic confirms it's using AI tools to code Unreal Engine 6, Fortnite, and more
items.summary: 'We are more concerned about the risks of moving too slowly than we are about AI skepticism.'

content.v: You won't catch me venturing deep into the coding mines, but even so, thinking about the comment-less form AI-assisted code can often take still gives me a stress headache. So you can imagine my reaction when Tim Sweeney recently confirmed via X , "Yes, we are now using AI tools to develop code for Unreal Engine."

This is unsurprising given that, in an Unreal Engine 6 blog post back in June, Epic’s executive VP of development Marcus Wassmer wrote that the company had "opened up pretty broad usage for code generation and AI analysis across our backend, engine, and game development engineering teams." More recently, Wassmer offered a follow-up statement to This Week in Videogames , saying, "We are more concerned about the risks of moving too slowly than we are about AI skepticism."

"Yes, we are vibe-coding things," Wassmer elaborates in his most recent statement, "That means our engineers are no longer writing the bulk of the code, but they are still guiding the tools to get the architectural result we want. We’re not ‘one-shotting’ the engine; we’re iterating with AI to ship features developers want and keep the engine within the memory, performance, and scalability envelopes."

This all follows comments made by Sweeney earlier this week, in which he came out against Steam's AI disclosure statements, claiming that they are " just as partisan as mandatory political essays ." The week before, Epic had announced an AI game jam ( shortly before walking back the AI requirement ), and the week before that the company said it had " vibe coded the Epic Games Launcher to be faster than the other guy ."

Wassmer added in his statement yesterday, "As we mentioned back at Unreal Fest in Chicago on stage and in interviews , we are definitely using AI to develop code and features for Unreal Engine. Almost all development happening right now is being done in the dev streams attached to Fortnite , [Unreal Editor for Fortnite], and UE6.”
@mattworkman Forcing developers to write a political statement to be used against them by the hate mob they’re helping organize is abhorrent. October 23, 2026

Epic is using a number of AI tools, though Wassmer specifically mentions Claude Code and Codex. "[These tools are] helping across a broad spectrum of development, with some particularly big recent wins being almost the complete elimination of non-deterministic cooking bugs which we’ve been fighting for a decade and an acceleration of work related to compressing shaders which both significantly reduce patch sizes," Wassmer says, "[Other wins include] a rewrite of a significant portion of the D3D12 rendering layer (which I estimated as needing three to six weeks of work for a single engineer, but the work was actually completed in about one week with a nice win on CPU time and fewer bugs)."

Throughout his full statement, Wassmer repeatedly touts the efficacy and efficiency gains Epic has made by using AI tools. He also argues that this is simply the shape of things to come for game and software development, adding that "The best way to counter any [AI] skepticism is through the quality of the games and tools we’re able to deliver."

"We don’t think it’s viable to take a halfway approach to AI in development," He concludes, "We think it’s best to just be up front with what we’re doing, share best practices with other developers, and make the best UE6 we can with the best tools available at any given time."

Tim Sweeney may not care for Steam's AI disclosures, arguing that these force " developers to write a political statement to be used against them by the hate mob ." Still, there's perhaps something to be said for the company's candour when it comes to its use of AI tools more broadly. Disclosing 'vibe-coding' allows PC gamers to make their own decision about whether to engage with a game or not. Armed with this information, I myself have one more reason to venture into the 'not' camp.

items.title: GTA 6 Breaks A Record, And It’s Not Even Out Yet
items.summary: Rockstar's GTA 6 is expected to be an enormous, unprecedented success when it releases on November 19, and new

content.v: Rockstar's GTA 6 is expected to be an enormous, unprecedented success when it releases on November 19, and new data only backs that up further.

Circana has released new data that shows that GTA 6 holds 29% purchase intent among US console and PC gamers. That means nearly 1 in 3 console and PC gamers in the US plan to buy GTA 6--this is the highest purchase intent that Circana has ever measured for any game.

Circana's Mat Piscatella said GTA 6 is a "rare cultural and commercial moment" for gaming, and the demand is fueled by the 13-year gap between GTA 5 and GTA 6. "Demand is expected to extend beyond software sales to include consoles, accessories, and gaming subscriptions as consumers prepare for launch," he said.
GTA 6 is launching just before Black Friday and the start of the holiday shopping season, and Piscatella said he expects the game's release could drive more sales for the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
“Its anticipation and popularity reinforces the growing influence of video games on the broader entertainment and consumer technology markets," Piscatella said.
While Circana's study covered purchase intent for console and PC users, the game is confirmed so far only for console. A PC edition, however, is expected in early 2027.

According to Sensor Tower , GTA 6 has already sold about 7 million units, driving $675 million in revenue. The company believes GTA 6 could hit 25 million preorders and $2 billion in revenue before the game even releases.

GTA 6 may indeed be a gigantic hit commercially, and one that helps lift the entire industry with increased sales of hardware and accessories. But anyone looking to buy a new console to play GTA 6 is set for major sticker shock, as consoles today are more expensive than ever. Not only this, but GTA 6 is not going to save the industry's many serious and deep-rooted issues, experts believe .
In other GTA 6 news, the game's file size has been revealed, and wouldn't you know it, it's massive . Preloading begins on November 12.

items.title: 《全境封锁 3》仍在积极开发中，育碧宣布《全境封锁》系列玩家数量已超过 5000 万
items.summary: Massive Entertainment has announced that The Division series has recorded over 50 million players across its g

content.v: Massive Entertainment has announced that The Division series has recorded over 50 million players across its games, just as the series hits its 10th anniversary. That’s a lot of +1 defense beanies!

The long-running looter shooter began life in 2016 with the launch of The Division. It came out three years after its flashy reveal at Ubisoft's E3 2013 conference which, at the time, exceeded expectation for next-gen gaming (remember when the guy closed the car door while in cover?). The Division 2 followed in 2019, but sales failed to meet Ubisoft's expectations. A number of spinoffs have come and gone since.

Massive Entertainment announced a new DLC for The Division 2 at a community panel at Gamescom earlier this year. The Echoes of Central Park DLC releases on November 3. It seems likely the new expansion — which adds a horror-themed flashback campaign, a stash space increase, a level boost, and more — will see even more players shoot numbers out of some guys across the U.S., both returning and new.

With those kinds of numbers, it’s no surprise Ubisoft and Massive aren’t done with the series. Tom Clancy's The Division 3 is also officially in production at Massive Entertainment. Originally headed up by executive producer Julian Gerighty (who also led Star Wars Outlaws and The Division 2), The Division 3 is now in the hands of creative director Mathias Karlson, game director on The Division 2. Gerighty recently left Ubisoft to work at Battlefield developer DICE .

Gerighty confirmed his departure in a social media post just a week after appearing on a livestream to promote The Division 3 . “So, The Division 3 is in production, right?” he said before his departure. “This is not a secret. It's been announced. It's shaping up to be a monster.
“I can't really say anything more than that. But this is, within these walls in Massive, we are working extremely hard on something that I think will be as big an impact as Division 1 was.”

Following his departure, Massive reassured fans that The Division 3 was in safe hands. “For our players, don’t worry, Agents,” the studio said in a social media post. “Our teams who built this world with Julian are still here, carrying it forward with an ambitious, unchanged commitment to the future.”

There’s no word on when The Division 3 will launch, but Ubisoft is making it a priority. Late last year, Massive Entertainment introduced what it called a "voluntary career transition program," as part of a move to focus on The Division franchise and its Snowdrop game engine.

items.title: 贝塞斯达确认《辐射5》将承认亚马逊剧集事件属于同一世界
items.summary: B社负责人Todd Howard确认，《辐射5》不会忽略亚马逊真人剧集《辐射》带来的剧情发展。新作所处的世界中，剧集故事与事件已经发生或正在发生，贝塞斯达规划下一部主线游戏时也会将其纳入考虑。这意味着《辐射5》与真人剧集

content.v: B社负责人Todd Howard确认，《辐射5》不会忽略亚马逊真人剧集《辐射》带来的 剧情 发展。新作所处的世界中，剧集故事与事件已经发生或正在发生，贝塞斯达规划下一部主线游戏时也会将其纳入考虑。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261028/1793193943_733493_jpg_r.jpg
这意味着《辐射5》与真人剧集共享同一个连续世界。剧集并非对既有游戏剧情的简单重述，其新增人物和事件同样属于《辐射》系列的整体历史。
不过，贝塞斯达尚未公布《辐射5》的具体地理舞台。目前只能确认其时间位置处于剧集事件发生期间或之后，Lucy MacLean、尸鬼等剧集角色是否会在游戏中登场也没有得到确认。
《辐射5》目前仍处于前期制作阶段，距离推出还有较长时间。贝塞斯达眼下优先推进《上古卷轴6》，两款作品均将采用Creation Engine 3开发。
微软最近一次Xbox重组后，黑曜石娱乐被置于贝塞斯达领导之下，但仍保留自身的管理和创作身份。黑曜石娱乐已确认将与贝塞斯达合作开发另一款《辐射》游戏，该项目与《辐射5》彼此独立。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261028/1793194293_104397_jpg_r.jpg
外媒详细报道：
《辐射5》仍是目前最受期待的在研RPG之一。B社已经明确表示，开发这部正统续作时，必须考虑整个系列近期发生的一些重大变化。
玩家还要等很久，才能玩到下一款单人《辐射》。这一点很难让人忽视，尤其是在亚马逊推出真人剧集后，《辐射》系列的人气明显回升。B社目前仍在更新《辐射76》，也在开发其他几个项目，但《辐射5》依然要过好几年才会推出。
现在，一个很值得关注的问题是，B社准备怎样处理游戏和电视剧之间越来越紧密的联系。亚马逊的《辐射》和很多游戏改编作品不同，它并不是把现有故事重新讲一遍，而是在已经确定的世界观里加入了新角色和新事件。这些内容也会成为《辐射》系列历史的一部分。
第二季会把故事带到新维加斯地区，第三季也已经在制作。随着剧集继续推进，它的故事对整个《辐射》系列未来的影响也越来越大。
B社的陶德·霍华德已经确认，《辐射5》会承认亚马逊《辐射》剧集中发生的事件。这也说明，游戏和剧集使用的是同一条连续的时间线。
霍华德在给BBC的一份声明中解释说，剧集里的发展会影响下一部正统游戏。他直接表示： “简而言之，是的。《辐射5》所处的世界中，剧集里的故事和事件已经发生，或者正在发生。”
霍华德还表示，B社在规划《辐射5》时，正在考虑剧集带来的这些变化。
不过，这并不代表露西·麦克莱恩或尸鬼等剧集角色一定会在游戏中出现。目前也没有确认《辐射5》具体会发生在哪里。霍华德确认的只有时间设定：游戏的故事会发生在剧集进行期间，或者剧集事件之后。
他的说法至少明确了一件重要的事：等《辐射5》最终推出时，剧集中发生的事情不会被直接当作不存在。电视剧和游戏属于同一个宇宙，B社也会以这个前提来处理两者的关系。
与此同时，B社最近的重组也让《辐射》系列有了几项重要进展。在微软最近一次Xbox重组中，黑曜石娱乐被划到B社的领导之下。不过，黑曜石仍会保留自己的创作特色和现有管理层。
目前已经确认，黑曜石正在和B社合作开发另一款《辐射》游戏。对于曾经制作《辐射：新维加斯》的黑曜石来说，这是一个重大进展。 这款游戏并不是《辐射5》，两个项目彼此独立。B社已经确认，《辐射5》目前仍处于前期制作阶段。
当然，玩家距离真正玩到《辐射5》还有很长时间。B社目前最优先的项目仍是《上古卷轴6》。这款游戏和下一部《辐射》都在使用Creation Engine 3开发。
在等待期间，《辐射》系列还有不少其他项目。《辐射76》会继续更新，《辐射3》和《辐射：新维加斯》的复刻版也将推出，亚马逊《辐射》剧集的下一季同样正在推进。

items.title: 《影之刃零》M站评分成国产最高纪录!超越黑神话原神
items.summary: 近年来，中国游戏产业迎来快速发展。《原神》《崩坏：星穹铁道》《漫威争锋》等作品在服务型游戏市场取得了亮眼成绩，与此同时，中…

content.v: 近年来，中国游戏产业迎来快速发展。《原神》《崩坏：星穹铁道》《漫威争锋》等作品在服务型游戏市场取得了亮眼成绩，与此同时，中国开发者也在不断推出高品质的单机叙事游戏。
《影之刃零》 预售进行中 ！叠加金币至高省40元，每周抽10份免单，还送大作优惠券！
两年前，《黑神话：悟空》的表现超出外界预期，不仅获得TGA年度游戏提名，还成为Steam历史上同时在线玩家数第二高的游戏。该作在Metacritic上获得81分，虽然并非中国游戏中评分最高的作品，但这一成绩依然相当出色。
如今，随着《影之刃零》媒体评测解禁，相关纪录迎来新的变化。据TheGamer报道，这款国产武侠动作游戏获得媒体广泛好评，并以88分的Metacritic媒体均分超越《原神》《黑神话悟空》，成为该媒体评分体系下评分最高的中国游戏。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610282118239216.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610282118242372.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610282118253759.png
这一成绩不仅让《影之刃零》跻身今年评分最高的游戏之列，也使其超越多款此前备受好评的国产作品。
尽管它能否达到《黑神话：悟空》创下的Steam同时在线玩家数纪录仍有待观察，但能够取得这样的媒体评价，已经是一项相当亮眼的成绩。
TheGamer同样参与了《影之刃零》的评测，并给出满分评价。在其正式评测中，作者特别称赞了游戏的战斗系统、Boss战以及精巧的关卡设计。作者透露，自己在一周内累计游玩了45个小时，探索了世界中的各个角落，并认为《影之刃零》充分展现了开发团队的实力，足以让这家工作室获得全球玩家的关注。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/28/small_202610282121086929.png
https://imgs.gamersky.com/upimg/new_preview/2026/09/24/origin_202609241120117407.jpg

items.title: "美国《原神》"跌落到斩杀线？昔日辉煌如今惨淡

content.v: 转载自微信公众号：TapTap发现好游戏
2022年，随着须弥版本的上线，《原神》在美国的声量走上了顶峰。
《原神》不仅改变了美国人玩游戏的方式，还变成了文化现象。线下联动从奶茶店一路开到麦当劳，还登上了时代广场的大屏；
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_11132880_9114348.jpg
漫展全是原神Coser，连大学都开了专门的原神社团；云堇拉着这辈子只听过“你好谢谢小笼包”的美国人听完了一整首《神女劈观》。
这个时候就很难不会有美国人问出那个问题：为什么美国人就做不出来这种在全球都能有超级影响力的同时，还能把本国文化推广出去的游戏呢？是因为美国历史太短了，还是因为美国人不懂创新，只会做美国游戏？
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_11132880_9114347.jpg
看着新一代玩家问出这样的问题，如今已经胡子拉碴，尿酸风湿，啤酒肚带娃的中年正星条旗玩家们则一定会回应道：
“孩子，2007年的9月24号的午夜，你一定在乖乖地家里呆着对吧？”
两道难题
2000年初的一天，彼得·塔姆特坐在芝加哥的办公室里，满面愁容，一筹莫展。
他刚刚跳槽到了一家游戏公司当副总裁。在90年代，拿Mac打游戏就像今天一样，不是说不可行，但说出来想不让人笑话是一件很难的事情。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_11132880_9114359.jpg
但这家公司居然在很长一段时间里，只给Mac做游戏——而且成绩表现还相当不错，射击游戏《马拉松》三部曲一炮而红，而RTS游戏《神话》更是将微软当时当家的《帝国时代》斩于马下。
这家小游戏公司，叫Bungie。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_11132880_9114349.jpg
顺带一提，塔姆特的前东家，叫苹果。一次经典的甲方转乙方跳槽。
而刚到新公司，就有一个巨大的危机在等着他：
公司要破产了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_11132880_9114346.jpg
他们的主力游戏《神话2》有一个致命BUG：如果用户将其安装在根目录下然后卸载，游戏会像你让豆包帮你清理C盘一样，直接一杆清台，把硬盘里的所有东西全部删除干净。
棒鸡不得不召回20万张已经印好的游戏，承担了接近100万美金的损失。塔姆特和其他高管们算完账后发现，按照目前的现金流，公司再过几个月就可以直接关门了。
面对这种艰难时刻，塔姆特决定打一个电话，打给另一个焦头烂额的人。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_11132880_9114345.jpg
埃德·弗里斯的困境和塔姆特正好相反：他就像王多鱼一样，完全不知道自己手里的钱要怎么花出去。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_11132880_9114350.jpg
他的老板很有钱，有钱到几乎变成了有钱人的代名词，他叫比尔盖茨。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_11132880_9114355.jpg
而这个有钱老板很喜欢给人派一些有钱也完不成的任务，而给弗里斯的任务是——
你去把索尼干掉。
当时索尼的PS2在全世界大杀四方，相比窝在房间里敲着鼠标键盘的阴暗宅男，在客厅开着派对，拿着手柄对着电视一起玩游戏的阳光男孩则明显是那个时代嘉豪的版本答案。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_11132880_9114353.jpg
索尼的成功让比尔盖茨很焦虑：PS2能玩游戏，能联网，能看DVD，基本囊括了一个孩子需要一台电脑的所有功能，万一索尼再顺便出个办公软件，以后大家不需要Windows电脑了，那咋整？
盖茨的方案是，我们也做一台游戏机，直接切他中路，我可以亏大钱，但索尼的日子一定不能好过。
而具体到弗里斯的任务则是最艰难的那一环：给这个新主机找到足够干掉索尼的游戏。
他们先飞去了当时的第一游戏大国日本。去问能不能收购任天堂，任天堂只是掩着嘴偷笑，然后把他们请了出去。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_11132880_9114352.gif
其他的日本公司也差不多，敬酒吃饭十分热情，但说到合作就直接发挥躬匠精神，红豆泥私密马赛，这个实在是做不到，团队最后灰头土脸的回了国。
在这个有钱花不出去的时刻，弗里斯接到了塔姆特的电话。
一般来说，这个时候的剧情应该是，棒鸡偷偷给微软展示目前在做的牛逼项目，微软大呼惊喜，两边开始紧密合作。
问题是，全地球人这个时候都知道，棒鸡在做什么。
在上个世纪的最后一个7月（也就是半年前），他们就在Mac发布会上，公布了自己的这款王炸项目——
一款叫做《光环》的射击游戏。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_11132880_9114351.jpg
当主持人将《光环》带出场的时候，用词非常的夸张：“这是我有史以来见过最酷的东西之一”。
这个称呼相当的有含金量，因为他真的见过很多很酷的东西。他叫史蒂夫·乔布斯。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_11132880_9114354.jpg
对于弗里斯来说，这个决定几乎是明牌——他看见了发布会台下，所有人闪亮的眼神和雷动的掌声。
微软最终以不到6000万美元收购了棒鸡，是20年后，索尼收购棒鸡时价格的不到60分之一。
2001年，《光环》进行了他的下一次展示，而这次的主持人，是比尔盖茨。
地球上大概不会有第二个游戏有这样的排面了。
棒鸡活了下来，微软有了游戏，只有被背刺的乔布斯相当的愤怒。他打电话给微软高层，对他们破口大骂，高管们不得不再次给弗里斯派发了一个高难任务：
哄好乔布斯。
战斗进化
《光环》发售之后获得了巨大成功。
游戏第一年卖了100多万份，听起来不多。但是初代Xbox主机自己，那个时候也就卖了不到200多万台。
当时选择买Xbox的玩家，多数都是为了玩《光环》，甚至只为了玩《光环》而花了几百美金买游戏机。
这是货真价实的台柱子：任天堂都需要红绿两顶帽子，而微软只有这一顶绿头盔。
初代《光环》的副标题是“战斗进化”。从某种程度上，这根本不符合规范：
一般大家都是把剧情关键、主题概念放在这里，谁把广告词拉这儿了？

content.v: 惊悚悬疑新片《雨夜之徒》近日在红磡一处殡仪馆外拍摄大型群戏，主演黄子华与林雪现身片场。现场布置逼真，一度让路人误以为警方正在真实丧礼外部署。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261028/1793190976_175497_jpg_r.jpg
现场照片中，黄子华以微卷乱发和旧棕色皮夹克亮相，造型颓废沧桑；林雪则身穿花衬衫与吊带西裤。两人与多名身着黑色西装、神情严肃的临时演员同场拍摄，营造出明显的黑帮葬礼氛围。
剧组在街道设置了封锁线、铁马、摄影及收音设备，并安排警服演员和外形逼真的警车道具。殡仪馆、黑衣人群与警戒布置组合在一起，引来现场路人关注。该场面疑似涉及“黑帮设灵”戏份，但影片尚未公开完整剧情。
《雨夜之徒》由歌手周殷廷首次执导，黄子华担任男主角，林雪亦参与演出。黄子华此次将挑战其演艺经历中较少见的沉重惊悚角色，目前影片尚未公布档期。

items.title: 腾讯又一游戏宣布停服！上线至今已5年

content.v: 2021年7月的时候，一款《宝可梦》官方和腾讯合作出品的MOBA手游《宝可梦大集结》曾经小小地火了一段时间。在姬的印象里，那段时间MOBA手游还是挺火的，再加上宝可梦的受众也广，偶尔就能看见有人唠这款游戏。
不过因为玩法、拉新难、角色数值强度崩坏严重等各种Debuff加身，也没过多长时间，姬就没怎么再看到这款游戏蹦跶了。非要说的话，就是看到今年日本亚运会带它玩的时候还小小惊叹了一下。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_5494539_9114157.jpg
然后前脚九月份参加亚运会，后脚……准确来说也就过了一个月，宝可梦官号和大集结各服官号就突然同步更新了一个坏消息。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_5494539_9114155.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_5494539_9114154.jpg
2021年开始运营，2026年宣布将在明年3月结束服务，满打满算这游戏也就活了五年多，国服比国际服开得晚还早关俩月，怎一个惨字了得。虽然放在各种手游里不算特别短寿，但作为宝可梦游戏来说，寿命还是比想象中更短一些。
什么，你说某方可梦也没活多长时间？虽然国服死得透透的，但如果姬没记错的话，国际服其实还没死，很长寿吧，宝可梦.jpg。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_5494539_9114153.jpg
如果你玩国际服的话：
1.现在已经关闭氪金通道了，也不给开会员了，某种方面上来说是好事。
2.原定的大赛仍然正常举办……不过说实话这还有什么意义吗？
3.运营结束之前，只要下载好官方准备的资料馆资料（aka离线版图鉴），就还可以在停运之后继续确认对战记录啦参赛证啦买的衣服啦之类的东西。好一个赛博坟头……
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_5494539_9114158.jpg
如果你玩国服的话：
1.同上，已经关闭氪金通道和注册通道了。
2.1月28日停运，2月3日连论坛和客服都给你关咯，看国服这边的情况应该是没有赛博坟头可供追思了。
3.如果你号上还有氪了没用完的石头，可以用余额换藤子家其他游戏的礼包，总感觉这操作似曾相识……
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_5494539_9114156.jpg
事已至此，虽然国外的比赛还会继续举办，但这游戏对国内这边来说，只能算是已经死了。如果有姬友想截图留念的话，建议在彻底停服之前上线一下哦。
晚安。

items.title: 老牌日厂来B站圈了钱就销号跑路？真相揭开

content.v: 收藏集——这可谓是近几年阿B非常火的东西了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_5494539_9114134.jpg
收藏集是付费抽卡式数字装扮玩法，说白了和学校门口卖的那种奥特曼卡是一样的。里面的卡牌分普卡、小隐藏、大隐藏，一些收藏集用了一定的抽数以后，可以解锁头像框、勋章、主页背景、点赞动画等站内装扮，很多粉丝有时候会为了表情包之类的去抽几发，姬也为了表情包去抽过。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_5494539_9114129.jpg
如果为了上面这种还好，如果是为了大隐藏去的……那可就要遭老罪喽~姬查了一下，9块钱一抽，抽到的卡可能会再出，40抽必出隐藏款400发必出大隐藏……要是非一点的话……
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_5494539_9114131.jpg
有那钱姬还是去买《火焰纹章》新作或者献给万代吧。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_5494539_9114147.gif
这么赚钱的收藏集，自然也吸引了不少官方或者UP主来制作售卖，甚至连一些Galgame的公司都来B站开号，顺带可以和大陆粉丝交流，扩展市场。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_5494539_9114130.jpg
日本的Purple Software（紫社）就是其中一员，紫社是一个老牌的Galgame公司了，他们拥有诸多的游戏，也诞生了不少让Galgame玩家喜欢的女性角色。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_5494539_9114132.jpg
紫社入驻B站的视频发出后自然也吸引了不少人，玩家们纷纷前往评论区底下催更，还有人说出了收藏集必抽。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_5494539_9114133.jpg
紫社很快回应了玩家的诉求，对于紫社的收藏集，玩家也很是支持，只不过几人欢喜几人愁……
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/28/origin_5494539_9114135.jpg
